0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: By the Twelve... I thought Ishgard remarkable, but this...<hex:02100103>We are certainly not in Eorzea anymore.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000020_TATARU
1.description: Hee hee hee! A tavern is a tavern, Alphinaud, here or anywhere else!<hex:02100103>Now, if you'll excuse me, it's time to do what I do best!

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000040_HANCOCK
3.description: (-???-)The Scions of the Seventh Dawn, I presume? I hope your voyage was not too trying.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000060_HANCOCK
5.description: Ah, yes, of course! Forgive me. Hancock, of the East Aldenard Trading Company, at your service. On behalf of Chairman Lolorito, I bid you welcome to Kugane, and invite you to take refreshments at our local offices.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000070_ALPHINAUD
6.description: Lolorito? I was aware his interests extended beyond the borders of Eorzea, but not so far as Kugane.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000080_ALPHINAUD
7.description: Regardless, I am disinclined to accept the hospitality of grinning merchants─especially those who serve a master with whom we have such a difficult relationship.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000091_HANCOCK
9.description: I do hope that business with the Crystal Braves did not rob you of all faith in your fellow man. Or do you really think the chairman is plotting to drag you into another one of his grand schemes?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000100_ALPHINAUD
10.description: I beg your pardon!?<hex:02100103>If you are trying to win my trust, you are failing quite spectacularly.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000110_HANCOCK
11.description: Oh dear, have I offended you?

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000111_HANCOCK
12.description: Once again, I must apologize. Too much time in the Far East, you see. One is compelled to talk in circles around everything here, and one finds oneself longing for the invigoratingly candid speech of the Ul'dahn markets...though I see now that this was neither the time nor the place to indulge said longing.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000120_HANCOCK
13.description: ...Might I suggest that we continue this conversation at the company offices? Too many eyes and ears here, you understand. 'Twould be decidedly reckless to say any more.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000130_ALPHINAUD
14.description: If I may favor you with the invigorating candor you apparently crave─it would be decidedly reckless to follow a man I neither know nor trust. Give me one good reason why we should accept Lord Lolorito's invitation.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000140_HANCOCK
15.description: Now, there's the young diplomat I was told to expect! Very well, then,<hex:02100103>I shall explain. You understand that you are come to a most reclusive and secretive nation, yes? One whose borders are closed to foreign trade save at this single port?

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000150_HANCOCK
16.description: Then it should come as no surprise that a great many parties have vested interests here. Merchants like myself are a given, of course, but for every one of us, you may be certain there is also an agent of a foreign government.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000160_HANCOCK
17.description: Many notable nations and empires have embassies here, you know─including, of course, the Garlean Empire, with whom you have such a...difficult relationship.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000170_ALISAIE
18.description: To paraphrase, Kugane is teeming with imperial spies, one or several of whom could now be listening to our every word.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000180_HANCOCK
19.description: Something to that effect, yes. Beneath this veneer of bustling trade, a war for supremacy is being waged between world powers. One might say we were standing on the front lines...just not in public.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000190_ALISAIE
20.description: I still have my doubts, but he may have a point.<hex:02100103>I say we accept his invitation─for now.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000200_HANCOCK
21.description: Our thaumaturges took great pains to ward these walls against all manner of surveillance. Where business dealings are concerned, we do not compromise on confidentiality.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000210_HANCOCK
22.description: You may avail yourselves of these offices for the duration of your visit.<hex:02100103>Come and go as you like, and know that you may speak freely here.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000220_ALPHINAUD
23.description: Your offer is most generous, but I will not enter into any agreement which would leave us beholden to you or your master.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000230_HANCOCK
24.description: A legitimate concern. Allow me to clarify, then: the chairman bids you consider this as an expression of his heartfelt contrition for the bloody banquet and the unpleasantness which followed.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000240_HANCOCK
25.description: Never having been one to put stock in words alone, the chairman deems the provision of material aid to be a more appropriate demonstration of his sincerity.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000250_HANCOCK
26.description: By sheer coincidence, your purpose here also happens to coincide with our own interests. That is, assuming you are come to aid the Doman Liberation Front?

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000260_ALPHINAUD
27.description: How could─ ...Hm. I will not bother to offer a denial. Aye, you have the right of it. To be specific, we are come in search of our Far Eastern allies, Yugiri and Gosetsu, whom we hope to assist in their fight.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000270_HANCOCK
28.description: The Auri shinobi and the Roegadyn samurai? Then you will be pleased to know that they have both come to Kugane.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000290_HANCOCK
30.description: Quite. They came here aboard a company vessel, you see. However, they encountered difficulties securing passage across the Ruby Sea.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000300_LYSE
31.description: The Ruby Sea? Sorry, I've never been any good at geography.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000310_HANCOCK
32.description: Forgive me. This calls for a map.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000320_HANCOCK
33.description: We are here, in Kugane. The sole open port of Hingashi, situated on her western coast.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000330_HANCOCK
34.description: Doma, meanwhile, is here, on the eastern coast of Othard, in Yanxia.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000340_HANCOCK
35.description: Therefore, if your friends are to reach Doma, they must first cross the Ruby Sea.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000350_HANCOCK
36.description: Alas, this is easier said than done as the Ruby Sea does not fall within the dominion of either Hingashi or Doma, being controlled since antiquity by a third party: namely, the Confederacy.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000360_HANCOCK
37.description: Said maritime collective is known for the consummate skill of its sailors...and for demanding that any vessel entering its waters pay a toll referred to as the “Ruby Tithe.” In exchange, the Confederacy's vast fleet “guarantees the safety” of those who travel within its territory.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000370_HANCOCK
38.description: Now, as I am sure you are aware, Garlemald conquered Doma some twenty-five years past, at which time the Empire saw no value in controlling the Ruby Sea. And thus did they turn a blind eye to the activities of the Confederacy.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000380_HANCOCK
39.description: The recently appointed acting imperial viceroy of Doma had other ideas, however. She has formally condemned the Confederacy and declared that any who recognize their authority shall be branded enemies of the Empire.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000390_HANCOCK
40.description: Bowing to this pressure, Hingashi severed ties with these toll-takers and forbade the payment of the Ruby Tithe, prompting the Confederacy to make<hex:02100103>it known that any merchants choosing to sail the Ruby Sea would do so<hex:02100103>at their peril...

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000400_ALISAIE
41.description: No wonder they struggled to secure passage to Doma. What captain would risk such a journey given the circumstances?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000410_HANCOCK
42.description: I am told your friends were not so easily deterred from their course, but I know not whether their persistence bore fruit.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000420_ALPHINAUD
43.description: I say we follow in Yugiri and Gosetsu's footsteps and attempt to secure passage to Doma for ourselves. We will need to cross the sea in any case, and we may learn something of their whereabouts in the process.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000430_ALPHINAUD
44.description: And should we find that they are still in Kugane, we can make the journey together.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000440_HANCOCK
45.description: In that case, I have some information which may be of use to you. No quid pro quo, I assure you─the chairman was most insistent that I aid you to the best of my ability...

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000460_GYODO
47.description: Endless and most sincere apologies to you and yours, yes, yes.<hex:02100103>This way, this way. Quickly now!

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000470_ALISAIE
48.description: Enough. Where are you taking us? Where is the ship?

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000480_GYODO
49.description: The ship, the ship... So very sorry to inform you, yes, yes.<hex:02100103>Long before was it pledged to another.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000490_GYODO
50.description: To me, to me! These ones are for Doma!

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000500_LYSE
51.description: <sigh> I knew it couldn't be this simple...

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000510_GYODO
52.description: Nothing personal, yes, yes? Just business.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000520_LYSE
53.description: Then business is about to take a turn for the worse...

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000540_LYSE
55.description: Come on, let's find a way out of here!

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000560_SEKISHINTAISOLDIER
57.description: Clear the road! Clear the road!

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000570_SEKISHINTAISOLDIER
58.description: You there, Kojin! We seek four foreigners─one a brutish woman carrying an unconscious Namazu. Have you seen them?

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000580_SOROBAN
59.description: (-Curious Kojin-)Four foreigners, you say? Ah, yes! Very rude they were, making no apology as they barged past. They went that way, I think.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000600_SEKISHINTAISOLDIER
61.description: With me! They cannot have gone far!

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000610_SOROBAN
62.description: (-Curious Kojin-)All is well. The Sekiseigumi will not return this way for some time,<hex:02100103>I should think.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000620_SOROBAN
63.description: (-Curious Kojin-)You are of the East Aldenard Trading Company, yes? Come with me.<hex:02100103>I know a safer way.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000630_HANCOCK
64.description: You are returned─and with guests, I see.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000640_LYSE
65.description: Our meeting went about as well as expected. We've brought the Namazu who thought to betray us. When he wakes up, we'll see what he knows about Yugiri and Gosetsu.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000650_HANCOCK
66.description: Well done you. When I saw the Sekiseigumi out in force, I did begin to worry, but I see my fears were misplaced.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000660_LYSE
67.description: Actually, if it weren't for Soroban, we might not've gotten away...

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000680_ALPHINAUD
69.description: Yet I must ask, Soroban: why would you deceive the Sekiseigumi to help us─foreigners of whom you know naught?

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000690_SOROBAN
70.description: Why, out of the kindness of my heart...is what I would like to say, but my motives are not so pure.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000700_SOROBAN
71.description: I chanced to witness your meeting with Hancock at the tavern,<hex:02100103>and saw an opportunity.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000720_SOROBAN
73.description: Like many, I came to Kugane as a trader to make my fortune.<hex:02100103>Kojin of the Red may serve the Empire as mercenaries, but Kojin of the Blue walk a different path.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000730_SOROBAN
74.description: Regretfully, most here would rather not meet our gaze, much less do business.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000740_SOROBAN
75.description: So I seek the custom of those less predisposed to dismiss us outright.<hex:02100103>Namely, the East Aldenard Trading Company.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000750_ALPHINAUD
76.description: Quid pro quo, is it? Well, there is no denying that we owe you a debt. What say you, Hancock? Will you consider doing business with our entrepreneurial friend here?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000760_HANCOCK
77.description: Rest assured, Master Soroban, that in matters of trade the company does not discriminate. We would be honored to hear your proposal.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000770_SOROBAN
78.description: I promise you will not regret this, good sir!

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000780_SOROBAN
79.description: Ah, yes─you sought passage across the Ruby Sea, did you not?<hex:02100103>I have a ship you can use.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000790_ALPHINAUD
80.description: You do? Well, then! Far be it from us to refuse! You have our deepest thanks.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000830_LYSE
84.description: That was Gosetsu! I'm sure of it! He's in trouble!

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000840_ALISAIE
85.description: Lyse, wai─ <sigh> ...I suppose we should follow her, then.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000860_GOSETSU
87.description: Hah hah hah hah hah! How many is that, now? Ten in a row?

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000880_GOSETSU
89.description: Oho! This is a surprise! What in blue blazes are you three doing here?

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000890_LYSE
90.description: I could ask you the same thing! We've been looking all over for you─and then I suddenly heard you screaming!

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000900_GOSETSU
91.description: Hmm... It would seem there has been a misunderstanding.<hex:02100103>Allow me to explain...

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000910_ALISAIE
92.description: ...So, in summary: you started a brawl with some off-duty imperial soldiers and were subsequently arrested by the Sekiseigumi, whom you somehow befriended and convinced to set you free if you could defeat a given number of them in single combat?

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000920_GOSETSU
93.description: Ten bouts for my freedom, aye!<hex:02100103>'Tis but a pity you came too late to witness the last one.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000930_GOSETSU
94.description: And with that, I am free to go, yes?

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000940_SEKISHINTAISOLDIER
95.description: Our word, once given, may not be broken─but we pray you make every effort to avoid future altercations.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000950_SEKISHINTAISOLDIER
96.description: Circumstances notwithstanding, my lord, we are honored and grateful to have witnessed firsthand the skill of a Doman samurai.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000960_HANCOCK
97.description: Ah. And we had just concluded negotiations.<hex:02100103>I gather my assistance was not required?

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000970_LYSENARRATION
98.description: I remember the water. How it turned crimson in the morning sun.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000980_LYSENARRATION
99.description: A shimmering sea of rubies, stretching from horizon to horizon.<hex:02100103>You could almost believe it went on forever...

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04001_000990_LYSENARRATION
100.description: But beyond that red expanse lay a land in turmoil.<hex:02100103>On the shores of Othard, our Doman brothers struggled in vain...
